methodology_note: A/B run of scripts/arc_loop_solve.py --game tu93 --target-level 3 with and without --no-hazard-prune. The pruner (arc_hazard_pruner.HazardMovePruner) fits a hazard model from the SEARCH'S OWN observed death transitions (no offline ground-truth BFS) and selects the toward/omni rung by IN-SAMPLE observed-transition trust (scored on those same observed deaths/safes, so optimistic -- a conservative gate, not a guarantee). The states-expanded reduction equals the pruned-move count (88). specificity 1.0 is on OBSERVED moves (no false-positive prune among moves the search actually saw); the reproduction gate is the correctness backstop and the L3 solve is preserved (reproduced=True). Modest magnitude: the pruner only saves death-move expansions; most of tu93's best-first search is non-lethal exploration the pruner cannot reduce.
